items.title: ZehenSync
items.summary: ZehenSync: a multimodal screening-support platform for mental health, built for patients, psychologists and psychology students. It screens and never diagnoses — a licensed psychologist makes every call.
items.summary_cn: ZehenSync：一个面向患者、心理学家和心理学学生的心理健康多模态筛查支持平台。它只进行筛查，绝不做出诊断——每次诊断都由持证心理师做出。
items.comment: 行业变化快，今天的热点明天可能就凉了，理性看待。

items.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
items.title_cn: 是否仍需要告诉 LLM 代理如何自我改进？
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-im...
items.summary_cn: LLM 代理日益推动自身的学习。自我改进方法将模型优化的各种组成部分委派给模型本身。随着模型能力不断增强，这引发了一个基本问题：这些能力日益增强的模型是否还需要我们来指定它们应该如何自我改进？...

items.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
items.title_cn: 英伟达的初创企业投资额飙升至650亿美元，但黄仁勋的退出让未来的交易蒙上阴影
items.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
items.summary_cn: 在过去九个月里，英伟达的私募投资价值几乎翻了两番，这得益于黄仁勋激进的交易策略以及其现有投资组合公司的估值不断攀升。
items.comment: 新趋势值得注意，别盲目跟风，适合自己的才是最好的。

items.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.title_cn: 英伟达承诺，目前营收将继续飙升
items.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
items.summary_cn: 尽管在声名狼藉的创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋离职后，英伟达陷入了动荡，但该公司预计其创纪录的营收势头不会就此止步。
items.comment: 基准测试成绩亮眼，但测试集和实际场景是两码事，别被数字忽悠。
